paev--dialoog--1: The plan contradicts itself: they meet at half past five, but Igor must go home at five; and Mari's line about rarely eating and often drinking juice connects to nothing. Make the arrangement coherent: when each one's day ends, where and when they meet, what they will do.
poes--dialoog--1: The unit's situation asks for EKI's closing exchanges where they fit: 'Kas veel midagi? – Ei, see on kõik.', 'Kas kotti on vaja? – Ei, aitäh.', and paying.
tutvume--tekst--1: 'Ta on 10.' does not say an age in Estonian; an age needs the partitive (aastat), taught in unit 3, so leave the son's age out here.

tutvume--dialoog--1: Each question needs exactly one answer in the dialogue. *Mis on tema töö?* fits Igor and his wife alike; ask with a name in the nominative, or with words that point to one person. The second model also answers without the text and guesses common answers (õpetaja, arst, kaks), so ask about what only this dialogue says.
poes--tekst--2: The second model, without the text, guesses small numbers (kaks, kolm) and common answers, so ask about what only this text says (which shop item, why, what was missing). Keep the partitive subject the unit teaches: *poes ei olnud kala*.

tutvume--tekst--2: Two questions were dropped and one more is needed. The second model guesses common jobs (õpetaja) without the text, and an answer it gives as a whole sentence is graded wrong, so ask for one short, specific fact, about one person.
